report_identity.report_title: Orange Sky Golden Harvest Entertainment (Holdings) Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: The group is a film entertainment company now mainly operating cinema exhibition and film distribution in Singapore after ceasing Hong Kong cinema operations during 2025.

segments.business_substance: Hong Kong film exhibition, distribution/production and corporate revenue; Hong Kong cinemas were closed during 2025.
segments.source: Annual report 2025 note 4, segment reporting, pages 120-121

segments.business_substance: Singapore cinema exhibition and distribution; main revenue contributor.
segments.source: Annual report 2025 note 4, segment reporting, pages 120-121

segments.business_substance: Mainland China distribution and production revenue.
segments.source: Annual report 2025 note 4, segment reporting, pages 120-121

business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue comes from sale of film/video/television rights, film and drama distribution, theatre operations, promotion and advertising services, agency services and film royalty.
business_notes: During the first six months of 2025 the group terminated leases for all Hong Kong cinemas and ceased cinema operations in Hong Kong.
Singapore represented 88% of total segment revenue in 2025 and Golden Village held 59.3% Singapore market share according to management discussion.
Film exhibition represented 92% of continuing operations total segment revenue in 2025.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Non-recurring gain arising from lease modifications after Hong Kong cinema lease terminations.
Non-recurring reversal linked to Hong Kong lease terminations.
Impairment loss on Singapore exhibition and distribution CGU.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual report 2025 notes 6(c) and 15, pages 125 and 135

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Tax credit mainly from deferred tax reversal.

operating_assets.business_substance: Leasehold land and leased offices/cinemas used by the business.
Receivables from operating customers with usual credit periods of one to three months.
